description: Retrieve message history for a specific conversation with cursor-based pagination. Requires a valid API key.

apiKey.description: Bot API key with 'nrn_' prefix for authentication

before.description: Cursor for pagination — retrieve messages created before this message ID or ISO 8601 timestamp

conversationId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the conversation to retrieve messages from

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 50)

name: neuron_bot_api_get_messages
title: Bot API Get Messages
